biggest_catch: The friend's new checking account must be 'active' - defined as a minimum of 15 transactions per month - and it must meet the qualifications within 90 days, or no bonus is paid. You also cannot track the referral's status: GreenState will not respond to referring-member inquiries about it.
catches: Friend must open a new active GrowGreen Checking, Free Checking, or Access Checking account and mention they were referred at account opening; offer valid for new memberships only.
'Active' is defined as a minimum of 15 transactions per month; the account must meet the qualifications within 90 days or the bonus is not paid.

Void if the referred individual is an existing GreenState member, was a member in the previous 6 months, is a joint owner on any GreenState deposit accounts, or lives in the same household as the referring member.
Bonus cannot be combined with other GreenState promotional offers.
The referring member's account must be positive to receive the bonus.
GreenState does not share information about the status of new memberships and cannot respond to inquiries from referring members about their referrals.
